## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed tape: cyclical and consumer staples strength vs Technology and Financials weakness, with leadership concentrated across a moderate set of sectors (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Staples lead: MO (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +10.87%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +7.39%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: LOW (1W: +11.26% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.72% | 1M: +6.23%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing strength: BA (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +17.57%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +11.26% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.72% | 1M: +6.23%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +7.39%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span 3 sectors: Tech, Consumer Disc., Consumer Stpl.).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -12.29%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology and core Financial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +11.26% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +8.72% | 1M: +6.23%) ABOVE TREND. Watch NVDA (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION — a minor divergence (1–2 majors) that merits monitoring but does not yet invalidate the NEUTRAL regime.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is mixed/soft with overall 1W weakness: GOOGL (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND is a bright spot while AAPL (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.65%) BELOW TREND lag; NVDA (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +2.70%) is in CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -0.44% — pockets of accumulation but breadth uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are showing clear pressure: JPM (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -4.29% with headline risk (credit-cap stories) offset by isolated bullish news at some banks — expect continued dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is mixed/defensive: JNJ (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +1.73%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +6.72%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.00% with selective strength in large-cap defensives.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Consumer Staples and Industrials leadership (MO, PM, BA, HD) and selected Energy names (XOM, CVX) showing above-trend momentum; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap Technology and core Financials (MSFT, V, JPM) until trend confirmation. Style: mixed / no clear Growth vs Value leadership given the split between cyclical strength and tech dispersion.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: GOOGL (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND — bullish news confirming price; INTC (1W: +18.11% | 1M: +19.69%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to monitor. BEARISH: JPM (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -1.60%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -11.56%) BELOW TREND — negative flows and sentiment to watch.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Staples and Industrials (both showing multi-name ABOVE TREND leadership and positive flows). BEARISH: Technology and Financials (continued 1W weakness and headline risk could keep pressure).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch for a positive 1W reversal to confirm exit from CORRECTION. AAPL: hold/violation of recent 1M lows would worsen BELOW TREND status. GOOGL: sustained 1W strength would help stabilize broader Tech. JPM: further failure to stabilize weekly support would confirm Financials downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+55): Google/Apple AI deal headline; price confirming — GOOGL (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND. BA (+55): Boeing deal headlines; price confirming — BA (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. MO (+50): UBS bullish note; price confirming — MO (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +4.31%) ABOVE TREND.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ADBE (-50): downgrade headline; price confirming — ADBE (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -11.56%) BELOW TREND. MA (-60): regulatory/credit-cap concerns; price confirming — MA (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -3.12%) BELOW TREND. AXP (-55): regulatory risk headlines; price confirming — AXP (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Style mixed (no clear Growth vs Value leadership). Consumer Staples and Industrials are showing relative strength — MO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +4.31%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +21.84%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.54% | 1M: +5.86%). Key risk: Technology and Financials remain weak (AAPL, MSFT, JPM BELOW TREND) and sentiment divergences (GOOGL bullish vs ADBE downgrade) require monitoring.
